title: Brannoch · all ten at 3×
caption: Ten brand-new dwarf designs beside the CC0 pawn and knight. Judge: which two or three are Brannoch?

title: Brannoch · at game size
caption: All ten at 1× on the grass beside the pack. Judge: does each read as a dwarf, and does any stand out as not Pixel Frog?

title: 1. Lamp-Helm Foreman
caption: Runs the ore carts out of the deeps: a riveted miner's dome with a brass lamp on its brow, a copper spade beard, a chalk slate of the day's carts held at his side. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Brannoch?

title: 1. Lamp-Helm Foreman · motion
caption: The idle (a heavy squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?
